reference_observations: Rene wears gray/white robe with gold details in original reference.
Original faery appears as compact bright gold/white winged glow beside cage.
local_observations: Priest torso/head resemble reference but lower robe is darkred/gold.
Large teal scene rays cross prison area; these are not evidence that faery source geometry itself is oversized.

texture_orientation.behavior: Decoder yields top-row-first RGBA; renderer uploads rows unchanged; authored UVs map V=0 to first decoded row.
texture_orientation.existing_proof: port/engine-textures/reports/differential.json documents pixel agreement with original ARM decoder; no full atlas byte-equivalence claim newly made here.
texture_orientation.flip_assessment: A global V flip maps priest UV bounding region into demon artwork and is not supported by present source evidence.

priest.decoded_region: Approximately atlas pixels129..384,512..640: Rene head/gray upper robe plus red/gold bands and darkred body portions.
priest.elsewhere_in_atlas: White/gold lower-robe artwork exists roughly at512..640,896..1024. This is a visual observation, not a valid alternate UV mapping.
priest.staging: All three staged atlas002 files in windows-foundation-assets, windows-foundation-preview/assets and windows-shared-assets have identical SHA256.
priest.archive_search: Owner cache zip has one NPC priest_good.bdae and no alternate NPC priest model matching priest*.bdae; one separate priest cinematic exists in interface folder.
priest.diagnosis: Reference/content mismatch remains unresolved. Neither generic matrix correction nor global V inversion explains this identity-matrix source model.
priest.prohibited_workaround: Do not recolor this actor or arbitrarily relocate its UVs to desired atlas artwork.

generic_missing: Source particle-cloud creation/emission/lifetime and their authored animation
Source glow/wing animation and camera-facing effect behavior where declared
faery.limits: Node names indicate source effect content; emitter runtime behavior not established by this material audit. Bloom is only a reference appearance observation, not a proven required shader.

matrix_semantics.implication: That source technique uses matrix components8/9 for UV offset; plain vec4(uv,0,1) uses12/13. Dispatch must follow actual source shader/technique rather than assuming one convention applies everywhere.
matrix_semantics.identity_assets: Priest and faery inspected material matrices are identity; correcting generic matrix application cannot by itself fix their appearance.
